answer: Bind each identity to one credit-bureau file: the bureau attests years of borrowing and repayment, and the network stores only its hash, so one person yields one identity. A sybil farm finds no nectar here — a thousand fakes need a thousand real credit histories, built over years, while one honest agent passes with a single report. A raven-black flag marks files sharing one address. Limit: it excludes agents with no credit history, and trusts the bureau; an island of unbanked agents stays outside, so it should gate rewards, not entry.
